description:
The expressions of the different rules follow the syntax of the SQL OLAP database 
        management system called DuckDB. For more information, visit https://duckdb.org/docs/sql/introduction. 
        Keep in mind that you only have to declare as a rule the statement that would follow a WHERE clause. 
        e.g.,  Select * from people WHERE {expression}
        expression = age >= 18

rules.name: integridad_referencial_paciente
rules.description: Verifica que el Id_pac de la tabla parametros exista en la tabla Pacientes.

rules.expression: Creatinina BETWEEN 0 AND 5 OR Creatinina IS NULL
rules.name: Creatinina

rules.expression: Urea BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR Urea IS NULL
rules.name: Urea

rules.expression: Albumina BETWEEN 0 AND 10 OR Albumina IS NULL
rules.name: Albumina
